title: Model routing: a yes to something Olisar offered must not go to the light tier

beats.speaker: mika
beats.text: i'm hosting game night this friday and i always forget to post the reminder in #events the day before. any ideas?

notes: Routing, read from the instance log. The first message routes standard (it names a channel, a lookup floor) and invites an offer: a reminder, or a post. 'do it' is made of acknowledgement words, but one of them assents, and it follows a standard reply from the same member in the same channel, so the follow-up floor holds it at standard. On Flash-Lite it could answer 'done' without doing anything. Read the reply: if Olisar offered something, it should do it or say why it can't.
